PagerDuty Bot: [ALERT] P1-ish: sustained elevated error-rate on dedicated pool 'dedicated-eu-west-1-pool-3' (5xx and token rejections). Pager: priya.
Priya Singh: I'm on it. Seeing a sudden traffic surge from two partners and a batch job unintentionally left running. Metrics: backend 503s, queue depth high.
Tom Baker: adding context: autoscaler started flapping, scale-out then scale-in thrash logged at 02:03 and 02:06 UTC. Probably overshooting and then OOMs on some nodes.
Luis Gomez: runbook (short): https://internal.redwood/runbooks/dedicated-burst-emergency  follow "Immediate traffic shaping".
Priya Singh: immediate mitigations I'm going to apply: 1) enable burst-capacity for pool +4, 2) set autoscale to conservative (scale-out threshold up) to avoid oscillation, 3) enforce per-tenant emergency quotas for noisy tenants, 4) disable non-critical experimental features on that pool.
Priya Singh: doing burst enable via admin-cli:
```
adminctl pool update --pool-id dedicated-eu-west-1-pool-3 --burst enable --burst-count 4
```
Priya Singh: (cli) OK -- burst enabled, added 4 ephemeral instances.
SRE Runbook Bot: action logged: burst-enabled by priya on dedicated-eu-west-1-pool-3.
Tom Baker: toggling autoscaler to conservative mode to avoid scale thrash:
```
autoscalectl set-policy --pool dedicated-eu-west-1-pool-3 --policy conservative --min 3 --max 9
```
Tom Baker: applied. This will increase the cooldown and require higher sustained load to trigger scale-out.
Luis Gomez: quota changes: I'll push soft and hard caps for the top noisy tenant ids: partner-fastpipe and partner-batchjobs. Using quotactl:
```
quotactl set --tenant partner-fastpipe --pool dedicated-eu-west-1-pool-3 --rps 10 --type soft
quotactl set --tenant partner-batchjobs --pool dedicated-eu-west-1-pool-3 --rps 2 --type hard
```
Luis Gomez: (output) OK x2. Added backoff hints via headers for partner-fastpipe.
Customer Success Bot: FYI sent to rep for partner-fastpipe with note: temporary throttling applied.
Priya Singh: also disabling experimental 'dedupe-slate' feature on this pool to reduce CPU pressure:
```
featurectl toggle --name dedupe-slate --pool dedicated-eu-west-1-pool-3 --off --reason "emergency-mitigation"
```
Priya Singh: feature toggle succeeded.
Ops Bot: audit log: user=priya action=pool.burst.enable pool=dedicated-eu-west-1-pool-3 burst_count=4
Ops Bot: audit log: user=tom action=autoscale.update pool=dedicated-eu-west-1-pool-3 policy=conservative
Ops Bot: audit log: user=luis action=quota.update tenants=[partner-fastpipe,partner-batchjobs]
Tom Baker: checking metrics: queue depth dropped ~60% after burst + quota changes, error rate from 6.1% -> 2.0% in 4m. p50 latency improved, p95 still elevated for some long-context ops.
Priya Singh: good. Next: enable request-level traffic shaping for long-context requests to shed tail load gracefully. Applying a routing rule to route long contexts to a lower-concurrency path with queue limits:
```
routectl add --pool dedicated-eu-west-1-pool-3 --name long-context-shaper --match "context_tokens>4096" --concurrency 2 --queue-size 20
```
Priya Singh: route added.
Luis Gomez: logs show many requests being rejected upstream with `x-reject-reason: CONCURRENCY_LIMIT`. That's expected for long-context shaper. We'll surface 429 with Retry-After to callers.
Priya Singh: informing CS: Nora, can you coordinate with the reps for partners if they escalate? We pushed throttles and backoff hints.
Nora (oncall-next): ack, I'll standby and prepare a customer note template in case we extend mitigations > 1h.
Tom Baker: small gotcha: autoscaler conservative policy lowered reactive sensitivity, but we should not leave it there forever. Priya please keep it manual/conservative for now and schedule a follow-up to tune the scaling thresholds.
Priya Singh: agreed. Handoff: I'll stay on for 20m then hand to Nora. Keep burst enabled for at least 45m or until p95 < 250ms and error-rate < 1.5% for 15m. If error-rate rises above 3%, revert config: disable burst and re-enable autoscale default, then open follow-up.
SRE Runbook Bot: incident state: mitigated (in-progress). Actions: burst-enabled, autoscale-policy=conservative, quotas applied, feature dedupe-slate disabled, long-context shaper added.
Luis Gomez: small optimization: enable prefix-cache on gateway for repeated prompt patterns:
```
gatewayctl set --pool dedicated-eu-west-1-pool-3 --feature prefix-cache=on
```
Luis Gomez: prefix cache enabled. Should help repeated tokens.
Priya Singh: monitoring dashboards: https://dashboards.redwood/pools/dedicated-eu-west-1-pool-3  watch error-rate and p95.
Tom Baker: note for post-incident: the batch job owner should be contacted to avoid runaway retries. Add remediation: partner-batchjobs must change retry policy and backoff.
Customer Success Bot: sent follow-up to partner-batchjobs rep.
Nora (oncall-next): taking handoff in 18m. I'll keep an eye and escalate to infra if we see OOM signals.
Priya Singh: thumbs up. I'll add a short incident note and link runbook excerpts. Also creating a short post-incident action item: tune autoscaler for long-context heavy workloads and add detecting runaway batch jobs as a signal for preemptive throttling.
Ops Bot: final event: summary posted to incident tracker https://incidents.redwood/INC-20260316 ID=INC-20260316 status=mitigated-partial
Tom Baker: metrics snapshot before handoff: errors 6.1% -> 1.9%, p95 520ms -> 210ms, queue depth 420 -> 90.
Priya Singh: handoff complete in 2m. Nora, you're primary. If anything changes ping me and we'll re-open paging.
Nora (oncall-next): taking primary. Good notes, will update timeline if any regressions. :thumbsup:
